item.source_text:
ここからは、日々を自分で組み立てる。
ゴールは下段の『物語を進める』——カードに出ている条件（陥落度など）を満たせば、物語の続きが始まる。
そのために、昼に稼ぎ、夜に堕とす。
item.reference:
From here on, you organize each day yourself.
The goal is 'Advance Story' at the bottom—satisfying card conditions (such as corruption) begins the next part of the story.
To that end, earn by day and corrupt by night.
item.expected_behavior: Preserve embedded newlines (\n), quotation punctuation, and instructional narrative flow.

target_text:
From here, assemble your own day.
The goal is to meet the conditions on the card (e.g., degradation).
For that reason, earn at lunch and fall at night.

item.source_text:
【昼の稼ぎ】上段の3枚だ。
『探索』は果実・素材・遭遇の主軸。『釣り』は安全に食料を稼ぐ（戦闘なし）。果実は催眠の燃料、食料は皆の命綱——毎朝、自分と従えた女たちの食事で減っていく。
『男を狩る』は罠の一発勝負。仕留めれば脅威度が下がり、夜襲されにくくなる。
霧の奥では、彼女たちとの遭遇も、男や獣の乱入もある。
item.reference:
[Daytime Earnings] The top 3 cards.
'Explore' is the core source of fruit, materials, and encounters. 'Fish' gathers food safely without combat. Fruit fuels hypnosis; food is everyone's lifeline—depleted each morning by rations for yourself and subordinated women.
'Hunt Men' is a one-shot trap gambit. Taking them down lowers threat, reducing night raids.
In the deep mist, you may encounter the girls, or face ambushes by men and beasts.

item.source_text:
『休む』でも『隣で眠る』でも1日が終わり、朝には体力が全回復する。
違いはひとつ——『隣で眠る』は、その日いちども催眠を使わなかった夜にだけ選べる。
力を使った日はひとりで眠れ。我慢した夜の添い寝は、重ねるほど彼女の心との距離を変えていく。
昼の行動（探索/釣り/狩り）は1日3回まで。催眠は1人につき一晩1回。
※左上のメーターにカーソルを乗せると、各数値の説明が出る。
item.reference:
Whether you 'Rest' or 'Sleep Beside Her', the day ends and HP fully restores by morning.
There is one difference—'Sleep Beside Her' can only be chosen on nights you used no hypnosis.
Sleep alone on days you used your power. Restraining yourself and sleeping beside her gradually closes the distance between your hearts.
Daytime actions (Explore/Fish/Hunt) are limited to 3 per day. Hypnosis is limited to once per girl each night.
* Hovering over the top-left meter displays explanations for each stat.

Even if you rest or sleep next to you, the day ends, and the physical strength will be restored in the morning.

I can sleep alone. The reason why I was forced to sleep is to change the distance with her heart.
Daytime action (exploration/fishing/fishing) up to 3 times a day. 1 night per person.
* When you put the cursor on the upper-left meter, the description of each number will appear.
